headline: aux_heads is MEASURED at last and it passes the headline bar: mass-weighted 2.271382e-03 over the 2.843136 % of squared gradient norm it holds -- 8.81x inside the 2.0e-02 bar -- with norm ratio 0.999496 and error cosine 0.999998, 176 of 176 taped parameters scored and 0 skipped. And the mask defect reaches NO USER: no shipped fold's token axis carries padding, measured rather than read.
the_honest_second_half: the per-tensor bar is NOT cleared: 89 of 176 scored tensors are over 5.0e-02, and 82 are still over A26's reachable 7.071068e-02, so widening does not rescue them and the row declined to offer it as if it did. What decides the scope is what those 89 are WORTH: they hold 1.1704e-07 of the compared mass, and 99.9999883 % of the compared mass sits inside the per-tensor bar.
why_the_headline_barely_moved_and_it_was: pre-registered branch G2 landed. aux_heads.distogram.linear.weight is 99.99998527 % of the compared mass and reads 2.267842e-03 in BOTH arms, because that head is computed off zij_trunk BEFORE the confidence Pairformer -- the mask never touches it. So the forward repair that took A18 from 5.174368e-01 to 3.865648e-03 moves this scope's gradient headline from 2.299551e-03 to 2.271382e-03. Both things are true and neither cancels the other: the forward was genuinely wrong and genuinely fixed, and the gradient mass was almost all somewhere the fix does not reach.
the_instrument_control_is_the_best_part: arm N, the unmasked re-run, reproduces of3t-auxheads' published 2.2996e-03 / 1.0482e+00 / 3.7941e+00 / 171-of-176 TO EVERY DIGIT -- in a different process, on a different card. A cross-process, cross-card exact reproduction is the strongest evidence this campaign has that its gradient instrument is sound, and it was produced as a control rather than as a headline.
the_user_question_is_answered_and_the_an: pre-registered branch E1: NO shipped fold's token axis carries padding, so the confidence-mask change reaches no user. pLDDT, PAE, PTM/IPTM and the ranking score are untouched on every served fold. The brief asked for the reassuring branch to be reported as prominently as the alarming one and it has been -- this campaign escalated a product claim from a source reading once (D90) and had to withdraw it. The mask defect is a TRAINING-REPRODUCTION finding only.
a_PROTOCOL_correction_the_row_surfaced: A26's sqrt(2) describes subtracting two INDEPENDENT error vectors of equal size, which is the right geometry when the reference is itself imprecise (A25). This reference is float64. So for a float64-referenced comparison the 'equals the ideal' bar is the one that actually binds, and quoting sqrt(2) x threshold there is too generous. Recorded as an A26 scope note; the row quoted the reachable bar because the brief asked, and stated the caveat rather than burying it.
what_remains_for_this_scope: nothing this row owns. The 89 over-bar tensors carry 1.17e-07 of the mass and the scope clears the mass-weighted bar by 8.81x, so aux_heads moves from UNMEASURED to MEASURED-AND-PASSING on the campaign's headline statistic, with the per-tensor tail recorded rather than rounded away.
provenance: of3t-auxgrad, VERDICT GO, concluded. Built on wk/of3t-auxfind. Re-taken on the taped forward_device path with the masks on, same boundary, same float64 0.4.3 reference, same bijection and cotangents; A18 confirmed in the SAME process that took the gradient. Seven controls. No number here is mine.
